probe: `blackbox ingest` cold start: one hook event from stdin to the inbox, real process per sample
protocol: each sample is a fresh `subprocess.run` timed with perf_counter_ns around the spawn; three columns (bare interpreter, `ingest --help` as the CLI floor, and the real ingest with a populated PostToolUse body on stdin); column order randomised per trial with a fixed seed; the inbox is removed before every sample so this is the first event and not the hundredth; warm-up samples discarded; nearest-rank percentiles from one sorted array with n and MAD beside them (P1-17); exit code checked and a non-zero exit aborts rather than being timed

budget.source: docs/BLACKBOX_FINAL_ARCHITECTURE_v1.1.md P3B-07 (cold start <= 40 ms p95 on the bench box)
